podcast.title: Literary Influence on Morrissey's Lyrics
podcast.body: Walt Whitman is identified as one of the literary figures from whom Morrissey drew inspiration for his lyric writing, contributing to his unique and literature-based approach. "Él toma sus influencias y Oscar White, de Walt Whitman, de todas las novelas clásicas victorianas británicas."
